_comment: The saved LinkedIn search. LinkedIn's guest API has no saved search, so this file is it. How it expands and what LinkedIn honours: .claude/skills/job-triage/sources/LINKEDIN.md. Regenerate from onetap with: python3 .claude/skills/job-triage/sources/linkedin.py sync-filters <get_my_filters dump>.

exclude_keywords._why: Keywords kept out of the search even when onetap still lists them. Measure a keyword before adding it here: requests spent, postings no other keyword found, keepers among those.

geo_ids._comment: onetap city or country name to LinkedIn geoId, used by sync-filters. Unknown names fall back to a plain location string, which works.
